goal.description: Short outcome the sub-agent should accomplish.

prompt.description: Self-contained dynamic context and instructions for the sub-agent. Include the task, relevant paths, constraints, and expected final report.

allowed_tools.description: Optional domain.ToolType allowlist for the sub-agent. Omit to allow every normal tool except Agent. Recursive Agent calls are never allowed.

max_turns.description: Optional number of sub-agent LLM turns before forcing a final response. Omit to use the default of 50.
